Attack (Z) button: A giant wave of light, plus a pillar of light striking ahead

Attack (Z) button: Fire a huge piercing black crescent. Drains 20% of damage dealt as HP

공격(Z) 버튼: 대장간 아저씨한테 들러 보렴. 골드만 있으면 검을 더 강하게 두드려 주신대.

공격(Z) 버튼: ...그렇다면 내 이야기를 들어라. 가까이 와서 ↑ 키로 말을 걸거라.

The Rusted Gatekeeper guarding the throne awakens!

Attack (Z) button: It is said the legendary sword is sealed deeper than this castle, beneath the frozen land.

...I did it. The Demon King has fallen.

Attack (Z) button: Light will return to the world now. Hurry home. Your mother is waiting.
